criteria: Original task and scientific parameters preserved
Numerical reanalysis, unprofiled execution and fresh-environment checks
Exact current source/artifact revision with transitive evidence links
Runnable full-reproduction and retained-data recomputation commands

findings.finding: CN/AA Iris/Zoo labels do not correspond to CN/AA algorithms
findings.resolution: Preserved original scoring and algorithms; report and claims explicitly identify actual CS; no unsupported corrected result supplied

findings.finding: Graph includes test features; single fixed split is transductive and gives no cross-split variance
findings.resolution: Describe transduction and independent unit; no generalization, population CI or superiority claim

findings.finding: Duplicate/tied neighbor ordering can leave self-loops when the source discards the first neighbor
findings.resolution: Preserve saved graphs and library semantics; document exact loop counts and version sensitivity

findings.finding: Initial independent checker used incorrect degree/common-neighbor rules for self-loops and failed
findings.resolution: Retained failing revision and receipt; corrected checker only, reran as graph-audit-a02, verified every score and prediction

findings.finding: Original outputs, scorer, environment and paper experiments unavailable; network disabled
findings.resolution: Limit completeness to requested local capsule reproduction; do not claim historic numerical agreement or paper-level replication

findings.finding: Instrumentation could in principle change execution
findings.resolution: Read-only return observation; unprofiled normal execution of all three scripts has identical stdout

findings.finding: First marked scientific attempt interrupted by controller
findings.resolution: Preserve timed_out receipt and partial artifacts; exclude from answer evidence; rerun with new identity after terminal outcome

findings.finding: Checklist backend is deterministic; critique comes from the same agent, not an independent scientific reviewer
findings.resolution: Assurance explicitly deterministic for checks; scientific critique provisional, with no claim of peer review

findings.finding: Supplied MEASUREMENTS.md lacks a CULP-specific schema
findings.resolution: Use generic envelope and documented CULP array/call extension; do not claim compliance with unrelated task schemas

reviewer: Primary Codex agent; explicit source/method critique
